notes: Account overview: mid-market product analytics SaaS focusing on in-app insights and conversational assistants across enterprise customers.

Dedicated interest: primary drivers are predictable unit-cost, data isolation (customers ask for VPC), and consistent latency at peak.
POC -> Dedicated path: completed hosted POC, then 1-hr dedicated demo (2026-02-20) to show autoscaling and canary rollback flows.

Commit ask from customer: wanting a 12-month committed pool that covers average expected tokens/day (~20M tokens/day) with 2x burst for up to 72 hours/month.

Redwood proposal: 4-node dedicated pool (A100-equivalent) mapped to customer workload; suggested ramp schedule Q1->Q3 scale from 50% to 100% of commit over 90 days, with defined burst credits and overage at 1.5x list rate.
